infobox_copy_copy._value:
Please note that the user of this form is responsible for checking the following points for each market on the Custody Market Rules & Control (CMRC) site:

  • existing restrictions,
  • client's eligibility,
  • offering of trading/safekeeping,
  • the requirements for opening a segregated account: the actual segregated account opening process needs to be initiated with the separate "segregated account request form".

Once all conditions have been observed the applicable boxes can be checked and the form be submitted to the client.

textdraw._value:
Non-resident declaration

The safekeeping account set-up, and the tax treatment of clients investing in Israeli securities depend on whether they are considered residents of Israel or non-residents of Israel according to the criteria defined by the Israeli Tax Authorities. 

Further, UBS is required to confirm the status of its clients holding Israeli securities towards the Israeli Tax Authorities through its local custodian every three years. In order for UBS to be able to provide the required confirmation, UBS requests its clients holding Israeli securities to confirm their status of being non-residents of Israel every three years. Should clients not be able to confirm their status of being non-residents of Israel according to the criteria as defined herein, such clients will have to be treated as residents of Israel in connection with investments in Israeli securities and, consequently, all their Israeli securities will have to be safe-kept in segregated accounts and will be subject to the tax treatment of residents of Israel. 

All of the following criteria have to be met in order for clients and/or their beneficial owners to be considered non-residents of Israel.
textdraw.name: ST_NonResident1

textdraw_copy._value:
As an individual investor (natural person), I/we confirm the that:

  • the State of Israel is not my/our permanent place of residence,
  • the State of Israel is not my/our place of residence or my/our family’s place of residence,
  • my/our ordinary or permanent place of activity is not in the State of Israel,
  • I/we do not engage in an occupation in the State of Israel,
  • I/we do not own a business or part of a business in the State of Israel, 
  • this year I/we have not stayed and do not intend to stay in the State of Israel for 183 days or more,
  • I/we have not stayed in Israel and also do not intend to stay in Israel for 30 days or more, and the total time I/we have spent in Israel this year and in the two preceding years does not sum up to 425 days,
  • I am/we are not insured with the National Insurance Institute in the State of Israel.
textdraw_copy.dorFieldStyling: DoR bullet point bottom margin reduction
textdraw_copy.name: ST_NonResident_Ind

textdraw_copy_copy._value:
As a corporate investor (legal entity), I/we confirm that:

  • I/we are not registered/incorporated with the Registrar of Companies in Israel,
  • I/we are not registered with the Registrar of Amutot (non-profit) in Israel,
  • I/we are not registered with the Registrar of Partnerships in Israel,
  • none of the partners in the partnership are residents of Israel,
  • my/our control is not in Israel,
  • my/our management is not based in Israel,
  • we do not have permanent enterprise in Israel,
  • no resident of Israel holds, directly or indirectly via shares or through a trust, or in any other manner, or with another resident of Israel, one or more of the below means of control at a rate exceeding 25%:
    1. the right to participate in profits;
    2. the right to appoint a director;
    3. the right to vote;
    4. the right to share in the assets of the entity at the time of its liquidation;
    5. the right to direct the manner of exercising one of the rights specified above.
